asr_text: Vogue also covered the 2026 season. It showed small pouches from Prada and Loewe. It also showed Celine's ultra-maxi and Altuzarra's large shoulder bag. It showed roomy totes from Totem and other brands too. This list matters. Large bags had not disappeared. Small and large bags appeared in the same season. We're not seeing mini bags spread through the whole market. Instead, they are back in fashion reports and on certain runways. Even so, trends now look different. Bags no longer play a game with only one size on the throne. Large bags are the luggage crew. They carry what we need. Mini bags are the stage crew. They catch the eye and set the mood. In 2026, the runway proudly shows this split in their work.
